name: md_convert
description: Convert Markdown given inline to HTML (escaped: raw HTML is never passed through), to plain text, or to a slide-deck outline split on headings. Covers a CommonMark subset (headings, emphasis with the CommonMark delimiter rules, code spans and blocks, lists, links, images, autolinks, block quotes, breaks, escapes, entities) plus GFM pipe tables; no link reference definitions.

split_level.description: slides: headings of this level or higher start a slide

catalog.source: original; CommonMark Spec 0.31.2 (2024, spec.commonmark.org) and the GitHub Flavored Markdown Spec 0.29-gfm tables extension, whose examples the tests reproduce
